lead: A card for one tool call: the trigger shows a status icon, the tool name and the state, and expands to the input and result (JSON), the error details, and approve / reject buttons when the user must approve. It opens by default on an error or a pending approval, and several calls can be collected into a group.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: In `requires-action` it shows approve / reject; once the user has clicked, you switch `state` to the result.
approval.rejected: The user rejected this tool call.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.trigger: The trigger (the whole row); `data-panel-open` when expanded
styling.status: Status icon (`data-state`); a spinner while running
styling.name: Tool name (with the prefix) and the state text
styling.panel: The expanding panel, its content, and each block of input / result (CodeBlock)
styling.error: Error details and their small heading
